reviews.title: Bulgaria flight
reviews.text: Great flight,smooth and punctual,on way back bit turbulence and landing bit bumpy.Otherwise great and friendly staff and best check in on way and returning.
reviews.author: Heather S

reviews.title: Uneventful
reviews.text: Flew on a new ish Xi'an MA 60. On time, uneventful. Cabin attendant appeared once for safety demo then disappeared to crew area and went to sleep.
reviews.author: Richard T

reviews.title: Good flight, despite a really odd name for an airline!
reviews.text: I was somewhat put out when I saw the name of the airline. I think it was partly because it was parked so far away, our bus seemed to go on for ever and ever to reach it. People even started joking whether we were going to Guilin by road! And then the funny name. But, once inside, I was impressed. Very impressed indeed. Brand new plane, 737-900 series, my first flight ever in this model. And the crew were so damn cheerful and polite and helpful. Very smooth flight, very soft landing. I would have no hesitation in using this airline in future. I cannot really comment on "value for money" as it was a group tour (with Wendy Wu) and we paid an all-inclusive fee. By the way, get a window seat on this route, you can really appreciate how mountainous China really is !!
reviews.author: Alex J

reviews.title: A pleasant flight
reviews.text: Small airline that provide a very good service. Our flight was used predominantly by Chinese nationals. In flight food reasonable with no choice but adequate for the time in the air. Stewards pleasant and efficient. Not a great deal of leg room. I must admit we had reservations when bused out to the waiting aircraft but could have been much worse.
reviews.author: Csider65

reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.text: We were bussed from the terminal to the aircraft and when we approached it and I saw for the first time the name “OK Airways” proudly displayed on its fuselage, my heart missed a beat. I didn't know whether to start laughing at this bad joke or start telling my wife what a wonderful time we'd had together as our marriage had been a blast from the moment we met at an airport many years ago. I decided instead to laugh aloud and hope for the best. In for a penny, in for a pound and hope that all would work out for the best. What a pleasant awaited us because the flight and service was good, making a perfect landing in filthy weather at Guilin. It just shows you that you cannot judge an airline by its name! Would have no hesitation in flying with them again. My experience reminded me of flying with Azul in Brazil. We had no option but to fly with Azul as it was the only airline that flew from Manaus to Tabatinga on the Colombian border. The airline turned out to be exceedingly good, great service, good seats and legroom, which was a real eye opener. Azul has better service etc. than Okay Airways but both performed superbly well. Shame on me for having doubted the capability and service of these two airlines.
reviews.author: Brian99993

reviews.title: No Space at all
reviews.text: NOT Okay. The main issue is the lack of space. My knees touched the seat in front of me, and I am not even tall. They have a kind of business class (12 seats), which is just the normal Economy class with other carriers. There were a lot of tour groups on board, which I think never traveled before. At the check-in in Bangkok, they just run over all the fencing and security had to stop the crowd. It was a big mess and nightmare. Another minus is that you are not allowed to used a smartphone or tablet during the entire flight, and there is not entertainment (I was just siting there for 5 hours, doing nothing). During a longer flight, you will get some snacks (e.g. nuts, muffin, or so) which is included in the ticket price. Positive is that the planes where all new, and I think they are well maintained. I will not fly with Okay again.
reviews.author: Stefan777-400

reviews.title: OK!.. better than OK!
reviews.text: I had never heard of OK Air but their schedule to Xi'an fitted in with the restrictive conditions attached to a 72 hour Transit Visa into Xi'an. As I am unable to read Chinese I couldn't check in online & there doesn't seem to be an English website. I wasn't convinced the airline actually existed until I found the check-in counter! My check-in was handled by the supervisor, it seemed as though I was the only westerner to have ever braved a flight on OK Air, especially at 2.30AM. Luckily I had arrived early because she had to email China photos of me, my passport, inbound & outbound ticket, hotel reservation for approval before issuing a boarding pass. The approval took about an hour but she wasn't busy & we had a good chat to fill in the time. Not much else to do at that time of day. Anyway, I boarded the plane & found myself up front in "Business Class", not flash but wider seat & less people. The flight was good, smooth & on time... Better than just OK!
reviews.author: gergmu
